summary: A homeowner brings a field hearing the gap between the insurance offer and the cost of rebuilding.
realLife: After losing her Pacific Palisades home to fire, Rachel Schwartz testified that her insurer offered about half the amount she needed to rebuild.
gates: An insurance offer and a rebuild estimate cover the same loss.
inGame: needs: an insurance offer and a rebuild estimate linked to one loss.

turns.what: A revised offer covers the estimate.
turns.pulledBy: The insurer accepts the documented cost.
turns.writesBack: The household can fund the planned rebuild.

turns.what: The insurer raises only part of its offer.
